title: Stated terms
description: A provider's terms for one tuple as stated at one time (REQ-QTE-6): its fee formula and, where its tuple sets a rate, its slippage regime, with when it stated them. Core keeps each tuple's history of these, keyed by its tuple; the terms that bind a segment are the last stated at or before it started, and before that the route's total is a quote.

tuple.description: The tuple they are for, by its provider and its two ends.

slippage.description: The slippage regime, where the tuple sets a rate.
